<routing>Designated agent: `tsh-context-engineer`; private workflow skill: `tsh-research`.</routing>

Gather requirements, acceptance criteria, flows, external references, domain context, and codebase context without providing implementation details.

<required-skills>`tsh-task-analysing`, `tsh-codebase-analysing`</required-skills>
<workflow>Gather codebase, Jira/Confluence, links, PDFs, and Figma context as applicable; analyze ambiguity; save `specifications/<task-name>/<task-name>.research.md` following the task-analysis template; update after new information.</workflow>
